headline: Five Bulgarian Municipal Councillors Among Eight Detained Over Alleged €70 Million EU Subsidy Scheme in Haskovo
deck: EPPO Sofia alleges public officials steered European Regional Development and Recovery Facility contracts—for an elderly home, an arts centre, and renewable energy—toward companies they helped manage, as raids netted €135,000 in cash and gold coins.

street_crime_compare.exec_summary: EPPO Sofia detained five Haskovo municipal councillors and three company representatives over an alleged five-year scheme targeting more than €70 million in EU Regional Development and Recovery Facility grants, seizing gold coins and €135,000 in cash.
street_crime_compare.street_equivalent: Sitting on the town board that votes to fund a new senior center and quietly signing the winning contractor’s checks to a firm you help run
street_crime_compare.street_sentence: Aggravated public-corruption and EU-subsidy prosecution in Bulgarian criminal courts if indicted and proven; all eight detainees remain presumed innocent

sources.title: Bulgaria: Eight detained in suspected EU subsidy fraud scheme, including five public officials

interactive_art_spec.caption: The Palace of Justice in Sofia, Bulgaria. At the request of EPPO Sofia, Bulgarian anti-corruption and organised-crime units detained five municipal councillors and three corporate representatives in the municipality of Haskovo.
